name: L-lysine; fermentation process; at processing plant
description: This unit process is a cradle-to-gate dataset of production of 1 kg L-lysine.HCl .

processDocumentation.geographyDescription: Represents production at the national level.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription:
Authors assumed that the production of 1kg of L-lysine.HCl or L-threonine required 1 kg of sugar, 0.5 kg of maize starch, 0.5 kg of wheat starch, 0.3 kg of liquid ammonia and 36MJ of process energy at the plant, supplied as electricity (50%) and natural gas (50%). The unit process was based on Mosnier, H. M. G. van der Werf, J. Boissy, J.-Y. Dourmad. Evaluation of the environmental implications of the incorporation of feed-use amino acids in the manufacturing of pig and broiler feeds using Life Cycle Assessment animal Volume 5 Issue 12 2011 pp 1972-1983 DOI 10.1017/S1751731111001078.  Blonk consultants reported water for fermentation of 140 kg per kg lysine.

"
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Life cycle inventory was originally assembled using the SimaPro software platform (Version 8.0.4.26) and was modified for submission using the OpenLCA platform (Version 1.3.0).
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Adopted from LCI published in  E. Mosnier , H. M. G. van der Werf, J. Boissy, J.-Y. Dourmad. Evaluation of the environmental implications of the incorporation of feed-use amino acids in the manufacturing of pig and broiler feeds using Life Cycle Assessment animal Volume 5 Issue 12 2011 pp 1972-1983 DOI 10.1017/S1751731111001078
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: 36MJ of process energy at the plant was supplied as electricity (50%) and natural gas (50%). 1kWh = 3.6 MJ. Maize starch, at plant/DE WITH US ELECTRICITY U was used instead of wheat starch. Water use was adopted from Marinussen and Kool (2010).  Also see Mosnier et al. (2011).
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: Data was collected during an ongoing project from 2013 through 2015.

reviews.details: University of Arkansas swine dataset mapped to USLCI technosphere flows and FEDEFL elementary flows for publication on the Federal LCA Commons. Review covers mapping crosswalks, cutoff flows, and export structure.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: These data may be used in Situation C2, “Accounting without interactions.”  This is applicable to accounting studies that according to their goal definition do not include any interaction with other systems.
